Exploding Kittens VR - November Patch

Hello furry friends! 😸

We have some fresh content for you to sink your claws into. As always, if you encounter any issues in the game, please send a ticket to our support team so we can investigate: https://sabr.gg/EKVRsupport.

New Content
We have added new items to Blitz Mode. This includes:
See the Danger – new to the VR game, this shows you the positions of each Exploding Kitten in the box.
Super Skip – similar to the card game, this allows you to skip all the turns you have, even if you have too many.

Private Games
Players can now create their own social hubs, invite friends, and play separately from the main pool. Here’s how it works:
Access this area by going through the Private Game door in the main Social Hub.
Create your personal code via the door lock.
Share this code with your friends, enemies, and frenemies who you want to play with. They will enter this number on the lock to gain access to your private game room.

Oh hey, by the way, did you know that we feature players’ gameplay clips on our social media channels? Send us your clips for a chance to have your content featured: https://forms.gle/saJfcxrhhKwsWUH18 

See later, ‘gaters! 🐊
